---
title: "Bootstrap table shorthand classes on table captions"
# bd-hfghrqvh: Q1 (quarto-pre/table-classes.lua + quarto-post/responsive.lua)
# maps Bootstrap shorthands written in a table caption's attribute block
# (`.striped .hover .sm .responsive-md …`) to `table-*` classes on the
# <table>, pairs `table-sm` with `small`, wraps `.responsive*` tables in a
# `div.table-responsive*`, and forwards a `tbl` float's classes onto every
# table it holds (the float div keeps its own unprefixed copies). The
# expected class lists below are Q1's output for the same source.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            # Unlabelled caption: prefixed in place, user class kept.
            '<table class="table-striped table-hover my-class caption-top table">',
            # `#tbl-` caption: float div keeps the unprefixed copies...
            '<div id="tbl-one" class="bordered sm quarto-float',
            # ...and the inner table gets the normalized ones + `small`.
            '<table class="table-bordered table-sm small caption-top table">',
            # `::: {#tbl-}` div form forwards too.
            '<div id="tbl-div" class="striped quarto-float',
            '<table class="table-striped caption-top table">',
            # `.small` pulls in `table-sm`.
            '<table class="small table-sm caption-top table">',
            # product-doc-theme's spelling: caption directly under the table,
            # no space after the colon.
            '<table class="table-success table-hover caption-top table">\s*<caption>\s*Adjacent caption\s*</caption>',
            # `.responsive-md` becomes a wrapper div.
            '<div class="table-responsive-md">\s*<table class="table-primary caption-top table">',
            # Multi-table float: both tables get the float's classes; the
            # nested sub-float's table gets only its own. (Not anchored on
            # the inner `<caption>Left` / `Right`: q2 currently drops those,
            # bd-ymyeef2e.)
            '<div id="tbl-multi" class="hover quarto-float[\s\S]*<table class="table-hover caption-top table">[\s\S]*<table class="table-hover caption-top table">[\s\S]*<div id="tbl-sub"',
            '<div id="tbl-sub" class="dark quarto-float[\s\S]*<table class="table-dark caption-top table">',
          ]
        - [
            # Shorthands are never left unprefixed on a table.
            '<table class="(?:[^"]* )?(striped|hover|bordered|primary)[ "]',
            '<table class="[^"]*responsive',
            # The sub-float's table does not inherit the parent's class.
            '<table class="[^"]*table-dark[^"]*table-hover',
          ]
---
